risk_note: RV2 (union/**). Every upstream union request through the pdd live HTTPS transport or the recording replay transport writes one app.union_raw_payloads row in its own autocommit insert, outside the caller's transaction, before the result is returned or the error rethrown: request summary {method, url without query, params} with appKey / client_id / secret / sign / session / access_token / refresh_token and any *secret / *token key removed (no headers, no raw body), gzip response body, sha256 of the stored bytes, Clock-based fetched_at and latency, error code (UnionError code / http_<status> / open-platform error_response code / NULL). Archive failures only log union.raw_payload.archive_failed (no request or response content) and never change the call's outcome. Demo adapters do not use a transport and are not archived. Without the optional DB nothing is wrapped and nothing is logged. No money, attribution, contract or migration change.
